question: According to the IMD Smart City Index 2025, which city retained its position as the world’s smartest city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zurich.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The IMD Smart City Index 2025, released by the International Institute for Management Development (IMD), ranked Zurich (Switzerland) as the world’s smartest city for the second consecutive year.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zurich ranked 1st in 2025 with a AAA rating, maintaining its top position from 2024.**
 
• **Oslo retained 2nd place, while Geneva climbed to 3rd from 4th.**
 
• **Dubai and Abu Dhabi showed the fastest improvements, highlighting the Middle East’s rising prominence.**
 
• **Singapore dropped to 9th, while Canberra fell to 8th from 3rd.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Swiss Cities’ Performance__

 __
 
• Zurich (1st), Geneva (3rd), and Lausanne (10th) remain global leaders due to strong infrastructure and citizen-focused innovation.
 
 
 
• Indian Cities__
 __
 
• Delhi ranked 104 – highest among Indian peers.
 
• Mumbai 106, Bengaluru 110, Hyderabad 109.
 
• India struggles with infrastructure gaps, governance, and mobility challenges.
 
 
 
• New Entrants (2025)__
 
 
• AlUla (Saudi Arabia), Astana (Kazakhstan), Caracas (Venezuela), Kuwait City (Kuwait), Manama (Bahrain), San Juan (Puerto Rico).
